title.en: TUJI1, official split (6,752 train / 2,147 test scans, five devices, one floor)
title.zh: TUJI1，官方划分（训练 6,752 / 测试 2,147 条，五台设备，单层）

dataset.name: tuji1
dataset.citation: Klus et al., TUJI1 Dataset: Multi-device dataset for indoor localization with high measurement density, Data in Brief 54:110356, 2024, doi:10.1016/j.dib.2024.110356

protocol.name: official
protocol.summary: the dataset's own train/test files (the setting of most published numbers)

skips.en: model-based: the dataset does not publish the access-point positions
skips.zh: 基于模型的方法：数据集未公开 AP 位置

notes.en: One floor with constant z, so the 2-D errors equal the paper's 3-D errors. The paper's 1-NN baseline (positive representation, Euclidean) is 3.34 m; here 1-NN + positive learns the missing value from the training data only (min - 1 dBm).
notes.zh: 单层且 z 恒定，二维误差即论文中的三维误差。论文 1-NN 基线（positive 表示、欧氏距离）为 3.34 m；此处 1-NN + positive 仅从训练集学习缺失值（最小值 - 1 dBm）。
